output.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS revenue,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o
  ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p
  ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
output.explanation: Revenue is taken as line-level net_amount for orders flagged is_revenue = true in fct_orders, grouped by product category from dim_products. Summed over all time (no date filter), ranked highest first. Shipping fees are excluded since they are not at line level.
